problem.name: Hidden quadratic level sets
problem.statement_latex: Let $q=p^a$ for fixed characteristic $p$. Given an oracle on $\mathbb F_q^n$ with $f(x)=f(y)$ exactly when $P(x)=P(y)$ for an unknown polynomial $P$ of degree at most two, recover a polynomial defining the same level-set partition. Coefficients are determined up to the partition-preserving equivalence.
problem.statement_text: Let $q=p^a$ for fixed characteristic $p$. Given an oracle on $\mathbb F_q^n$ with $f(x)=f(y)$ exactly when $P(x)=P(y)$ for an unknown polynomial $P$ of degree at most two, recover a polynomial defining the same level-set partition. Coefficients are determined up to the partition-preserving equivalence.

quantum.headline_latex: $\operatorname{poly}(n,\log q)$ quantum time over constant-characteristic fields, by Decker--Draisma--Ivanyos--Santha's reduction from quadratic level sets to hidden symmetry and hidden subgroups.

classical.headline_latex: Classical recovery can enumerate the finite coefficient space in $q^{O(n^2)}$ time. Collision lower bounds for the hidden-label oracle give a positive-power-of-$q$ obstruction for its hard subfamilies.
